rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a Roberts opinion reversing on a narrow as-applied basis, sustaining § 922(g)(3) only where the government proves a meaningful temporal nexus to active, ongoing unlawful use under Bruen/Rahimi’s “why/how” analogue framework. Thomas and Gorsuch likely dissent (possibly separately), while one or more majority justices (especially Barrett/Kavanaugh/Alito) may concur to emphasize anti-rewriting limits and the temporality/stale-evidence constraint.
